koks_template:
Straight perfect rectangular phone. Remove any perspective, remove any skew. Phone sides aligned to grid-lines. Phone, phone screen aligned to grid, straight vertical top-view, professional technical product photo.

{texts}. {keys}
cutout: This is an RGBA image with transparency. Keep exactly the same mobile phone, change only the background: remove the background completely. Centered, isolated object. The image has alpha channel and the background is transparent.
fix_keypad_tpl: Keep exactly the same image: the same keys, shapes, colours, lighting, font and positions. Change only the printed key labels so they read exactly, row by row: {key_rows}. {key_icons}
fix_text: Keep exactly the same image. Change only the text so it reads exactly '{text}', in the same font, size, colour and position.
fix_key_row: Keep exactly the same image: the same keys, shapes, colours, lighting, font and positions. Change only the printed labels on the keys so they read exactly, from left to right: {text}
fix_key_letters: Keep exactly the same image, including the digit, its size and position. Add only the small printed letters '{text}' on the empty area to the right of the digit, in the same font and colour as the digit, about 55% of the digit's height, vertically centred on the digit. Change nothing else.
